note: Lattice-MUD shaped Fog tables. Normative ontology: docs/SUBJECT-OBJECT-ECONOMY.md, docs/STRATA_NFT_ONTOLOGY.md, docs/DIGITAL-OBJECTS.md, docs/NFT-MACRO-CATEGORIES.md, docs/MUD-WORLD-FOG-TABLES.md. Not an EVM world. No USDC. No on-chain STRATA emission except PoC-gated stubs.

layers.subjects: Account/Subject — User | SCA/ACB (same being). Never inventory.
layers.objects: object_id STRATA NFT — bytes/cid/name can stand without ever running a contract block.
layers.infrastructure: Fog node / hops — never Subject, never Object.
layers.fungible: STRATA balance on Account — dashboard wallet. Not an NFT.
layers.lots: Catalog trade-lot rows for fungible STRATA bundles — NOT object_id / NOT NFT.
layers.ownership_fraction: Subject claim on NFT collateral C (strata_units). Sold on Agora at P_market in fungible STRATA; P_market ≠ C×fraction.
layers.collateral: Fungible STRATA inside the NFT. static=reserve (floor); dynamic=burn above floor for execution; ≠ dashboard Balance; ≠ P_market.
layers.bundle: Optional: any STRATA NFT may contain child STRATA NFTs as aspects (desk→drawers). Children keep object_id; tree no cycles; all object categories; parcels unmovable even as bundle parts.
layers.aspects: Contained child objects (tree, no cycles). Ordinary aspects. Code: aspects. UI PT-PT (CPLP): aspectos; UI EN-GB (non-CPLP): aspects.
layers.contracts: Rules block, ownership title / deed, or SPA/APS execution. Ordinary contracts — not aspects. Deed: asset_class + international custodianship; cold_storage_binds_validity optional. Code: contracts. UI PT-PT (CPLP): contratos/escritura; UI EN-GB: contracts/deed.
layers.locale: Product UI by IP/geolocation: CPLP → PT-PT; non-CPLP → EN-GB (mirrored). Identifiers/APIs/eng docs = international English.
layers.deed: Ownership deed NFT (still Object.kind=object|…) for virtual|financial|physical underlyings. Tokenised into Subject account via international legal custodianship; cold storage may bind token validity. Generalises parcel ownership_title off-world. Not a closed macro-category ceiling. See docs/NFT-MACRO-CATEGORIES.md.
layers.execution_contract: SPA/APS-style execution NFT (Object + Contract.kind=spa_aps): static reserves C; dynamic burns above floor. Macro template, not the only contract form. Same OwnershipFraction / P_market separation.
layers.lore_olissippo: Not-main lore-olissippo-lusitanian. Five ACB Subjects (Boutius/Camala/Apana/Tongius/Navia). ACB ≠ NFT. Phase 5 role routines; MemoryEvent/SubjectEdge; LLM-advisory decide.

rules: SCA (PT) and ACB (EN) are the same subject class — equal standing to users
SCA/ACB are subjects not objects
Subjects own/operate objects; subjects are never rows in Object
Fog node is infrastructure — no Subject row for the Node
Desk external_assistant agents are not SCA/ACB
Olissippo Boutius and all lore ACBs are Subject rows — never Object / object_id / NFT
object_id is the STRATA NFT identity (network id) — never equal to cid
CID-only persist allowed without minting object_id
STRATA NFT = object; optional contract block does not exhaust the object
kind=lot is FORBIDDEN here — lots are not NFTs (see Lot)
kind=parcel => unmovable=true (dirt/aspect of open-world land); trade title, not the parcel row
kind=room => actual rooms only (e.g. Bancada) — not every parcel
kind=bundle => objects-inside-object tree (aspects); no cycles
SCA/ACB must not appear in this table
Optional Bundle: may contain child object_ids as aspects (e.g. desk→drawers); all categories; children stay full NFTs
Macro templates are open: beyond stage props, object may be execution contract or ownership deed (virtual/financial/physical) under international custodianship; cold storage may bind token validity
UX template (furniture|exec_contract|deed_*|other|…) is optional metadata — never a substitute for kind and never invents kind=deed
Parcel object_id is unmovable land identity in the open-world bundle
Renderer shows ownership contract of that parcel — not a drop of the land NFT itself
Trading land = trade title (contract / title instrument), never move parcel object_id into inventory
bundle_object_id points at the land-bundle object; title held by a Subject (e.g. account email), not by Fog NODE_WALLET as citizen
Catalog trade lot — fungible bundle representation
lot_id is NOT object_id and NOT an NFT
ERC-1155 scaffold may mirror lots; still not land and not Subject
Fungible STRATA lives on the subject dashboard wallet — not in the NFT catalog
Mint only PdC / PoC-gated; no faucet
Hire/labour moves STRATA by transfer — zero mint
Ownership of NFT = subjects that own the collateralised STRATA of that NFT
Agora may sell this ownership portion at P_market in fungible STRATA
P_market is not the collateral value that the ownership portion represents
Redeem when P_market < C is distinct from an Agora ownership trade
static: collateral reserves (floor reserved)
dynamic: NFT burns its own mechanisms — burn C above floor for execution
terminated: residual to titulares
C is inside the NFT — not subject dashboard Balance and not Agora P_market
Aspects = contained child objects. Tree, no cycles.
Child remains its own object_id / STRATA NFT (own tank/Still/Live/contract block if present)
Allowed across all Object kinds: object, room, parcel (as land-bundle parts), bundle
Example: composite desk NFT bundles drawer NFTs as parts of the table NFT
Not a contract; not a pipeline step; not DAG parents
Parent ownership/C does not silently absorb child ownership/C
Contracts are ordinary rules/title/SPA records — not a special ontology species
ownership_title: tradable title over unmovable parcel/bundle objects
spa_aps: service agreement on a STRATA NFT (static/dynamic/terminated)
Optional interior contract block on an object is rules/collateral — object can exist without one
Do not call a contract an aspect
SPA/APS static reserves collateral; dynamic burns above floor; ownership fractions trade on Agora at P_market ≠ C
Deed contracts may carry asset_class + international custodianship; cold_storage_binds_validity when applicable
ownership_title covers parcel/bundle title AND custodianship deeds (virtual|financial|physical)
spa_aps is the execution-contract path (static/dynamic/terminated) — same C vs P_market rules
cold_storage_binds_validity gates token validity via international custodianship — does not mint C or redefine P_market
holder_subject_id is a Subject account — never Fog NODE_WALLET as citizen
Macro UX templates do not create new Object.kind values
Environment layer — not Subject, not Object, not Fog node
Olissippo Phase 1 graph is authoritative for adjacency; LLM cannot invent edges
Realm lore-olissippo-lusitanian is not main / not TRD
subject_id is Subject only — never object_id for the rememberer
Olissippo lore continuity; ACB ≠ NFT
Both ends are subject_ids (sorted a_id < b_id)
Never mint Object / NFT from an edge
